item.title: REDS ADD TAWANDA CHIREWA TO RANKS
item.description: Incoming transfers proudly sponsored by The Investment Room. Barnsley FC are delighted to announce the loan signing of Tawanda Chirewa from Wolverhampton Wanderers, with the 22-year-old winger joining the Reds until the end of the season. Chirewa arrives at Oakwell with valuable Premier League experience, having made ten Premier League appearances for Wolves since joining the club in 2023. item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm the loan departure of Fábio Jaló to Oldham Athletic until the end of the 2025/26 campaign.
